source: DHM Islamic Level 1 · lesson 14 «How We Pray» (11 steps). Sacred sayings are flagged and their audio waits for Dr. Hassan's review.
topic: Step 5: sujūd — the seven body parts on the ground, and what we say

words.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

order.en: Put the steps of the prayer in order

quiz.ar: كَمْ عُضْوًا عَلَى الأَرْضِ فِي السُّجُودِ؟
quiz.en: How many body parts touch the ground in sujūd?
What do we say in sujūd?
opts: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
Our Lord, all praise is for You

quiz.en: Which one is NOT on the ground in sujūd?

move.ar: اُسْجُدْ مَعَ كُوكُو، وَعُدَّ السَّبْعَةَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ!
move.en: Do sujūd with Koko and check all seven: forehead + nose, 2 palms, 2 knees, toes of both feet!

parents.summary: Sujūd: seven body parts on the ground (forehead+nose, palms, knees, toes) and Subḥāna Rabbiya l-Aʿlā three times.

try.en: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High

parents.tip: Watch his sujūd and count the seven parts with him; elbows stay off the ground.
